name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Who can train, who needs a look, and what the rules say. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Not fully available
sections.note: Out or on modified training today, with the expected return.
sections.sql: select name as athlete, squad, status, diagnosis, expected_return from availability where status <> 'available' order by squad, status, name

sections.title: Wellness this morning
sections.note: Forms not in, scores well below the athlete's own 28-day normal, or short sleep.
sections.sql: select w.name as athlete, w.squad, case when not w.submitted then 'not submitted' else w.score::text end as score, w.baseline as normal, w.sleep_hours, w.comment from wellness_today w cross join settings s where not w.submitted or w.vs_baseline <= -s.wellness_drop or w.sleep_hours < s.sleep_min order by w.squad, w.name

sections.title: Load spikes
sections.note: Seven-day load against the 28-day weekly average, over the ratio set in settings. Athletes who are out are left off.
sections.sql: select l.name as athlete, l.squad, round(l.acute) as last_7_days, round(l.chronic) as weekly_average, l.acwr as ratio from load_status l cross join settings s where l.acwr > s.acwr_high and l.status <> 'out' order by l.acwr desc

sections.title: Concussions in recovery
sections.note: The earliest dates for contact training and for competition, and whether a doctor has cleared them.
sections.sql: select athlete, squad, reported_on, symptoms_resolved_on as symptom_free_from, contact_ok_from as contact_from, competition_ok_from as play_from, doctor_cleared from concussion_status where status <> 'cleared' or reported_on > current_date - 28 order by reported_on desc

name: loads
title: Training load
subtitle: Session RPE (minutes x RPE) for every active athlete: last 7 days, the 28-day weekly average and the ratio.

sections.title: Every athlete
sections.sql: select name as athlete, squad, status as today, sessions_7d as sessions, round(acute) as last_7_days, round(chronic) as weekly_average, round(last_week) as week_before, acwr as ratio from load_status order by squad, acwr desc nulls last

name: injuries
title: Injury register
subtitle: Every injury this season with days lost, the stage reached and who cleared it.

sections.title: Open
sections.sql: select number, athlete, squad, reported_on, diagnosis, status, days_out, stage_reached, expected_return from injury_register where status <> 'cleared' order by reported_on desc

sections.title: Cleared
sections.sql: select number, athlete, squad, reported_on, diagnosis, days_out, cleared_on, cleared_by_name as cleared_by, cleared_by_role as role from injury_register where status = 'cleared' order by cleared_on desc

sections.title: Days lost by body area and mechanism
sections.sql: select coalesce(body_area, 'not recorded') as body_area, coalesce(mechanism, 'not recorded') as mechanism, count(*) as injuries, sum(days_out) as days_lost from injury_register group by 1, 2 order by days_lost desc
